failure_boundary.problem: Prepared dense-SFT successors had no maintained create-once CPU Job that could run the native preflight in the exact pinned image and return a source-bound receipt.
failure_boundary.unsafe_action_rejected: Do not replay or hand-edit the historical one-off CPU Job manifest.

repair.source_checkout: one clean exact Git commit; tracked or untracked worktree changes reject
repair.create_semantics: server dry-run, exact duplicate check, fsynced do-not-retry intent, exactly one kubectl create

job_contract.failed_job_alerts: off at Job root and Pod template before create

repair.terminal_collection: Require the exact Job UID, one admitted Kueue v1beta2 Workload at priority 10000 with exact CPU/memory/storage resource usage, one zero-restart zero-GPU Pod, exact runtime image digest, reviewed default-ServiceAccount pull-secret behavior, and exactly one sanitized native receipt line.
repair.private_output: The worker suppresses native stdout/stderr and exposes only receipt scalars, digests, counts and status.

checkpoint_policy_preserved.qualification: Seal every accepted checkpoint and independently prove reload before resume or promotion.
